description:
**Job Title:** LEAD ADMINISTRATOR L1
  
**City:** Hyderabad
  
**State/Province:** Telangana
  
**Posting Start Date:** 9/8/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to resolve high\-priority incidents through advanced troubleshooting, ensure SLA compliance, analyse system performance trends, and create mitigation measures by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  

͏
  
  

Areas of responsibility
  
  

Triaging and resolution of tickets\-Provide resolution to high priority incident (P2\) tickets, performing advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis to ensure timely closure.
  
  

SLA Monitoring\-Ensure SLA compliance for assigned technology areas and ensure proactive escalation management.
  
  

Performance tuning and optimization\-Analyse system performance data, coordinate findings on system behaviour, and support capacity planning initiatives to enhance overall system efficiency.
  
  

Perform system Improvements\-Create mitigation measures to evaluate new tools or improvements by collaborating with technical teams.
  
  

Handling disaster recovery\-Perform security assessments and recovery drills, and implement necessary controls to ensure compliance with established security standards.
  
  

Reporting and stakeholder engagement\-Participate in weekly and monthly service review meetings, provide updates on performance and issues, and support stakeholder communication to ensure transparency and service alignment.
  
  

Team Management\-Collaborate with team members to resolve open tickets and service requests.
  
  

Knowledge base and continuous learningÂ Contribute to updating SOPs, knowledge articles and maintaining the knowledge repository for the purpose of future ticket resolution.
  
  

͏

͏
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Network Data Admin .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

Sr Technical Service Desk Analyst -Level 2
description:
**What success looks like in this role:**

We are seeking a Senior Technical Service Desk L2 to provide advanced technical support for end\-user computing, applications, and infrastructure\-related issues. The role involves troubleshooting complex incidents, mentoring L1 analysts, managing escalations, and ensuring timely resolution of service requests while maintaining high customer satisfaction.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide second\-level technical support for hardware, software, operating systems, and network\-related issues.
* Handle escalated incidents from the L1 Service Desk team.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Windows, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, VPN, and enterprise applications.
* Administer user accounts, permissions, and group policies in Active Directory.
* Support Microsoft Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Exchange environments.
* Diagnose and resolve desktop, laptop, printer, and mobile device issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive measures.
* Work closely with infrastructure, network, security, and application support teams.
* Create and maintain knowledge base articles and technical documentation.
* Monitor ticket queues and ensure SLA compliance.
* Support software deployments, patching, and system upgrades.
* Provide technical guidance and support to L1 analysts.

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications and services.
* Hands\-on experience with Active Directory, Azure AD, Entra ID, and Group Policies.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi\-Fi, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience with ticketing tools such as ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira, or Ivanti.
* Understanding of endpoint management tools such as SCCM, Intune, or MECM.
* Familiarity with remote support tools and desktop management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* ITIL Foundation Certification preferred.
* Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator or related certifications preferred.
* Experience supporting enterprise environments.

**Experience**

**2\-5 Years** of experience in Service Desk, Technical Support, Desktop Support, or IT Operations via phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems.


**Working Hours**

Required to work for a total of 45 hours per week. The normal office hours are 10 hours per day, inclusive of unpaid 1 hour break. Your work schedule will be determined as communicated by your manager. You may be required to work on shifts (morning/evening/night shift) as notified to you by your manager.


**Key Competencies**

* Advanced Troubleshooting
* Incident and Problem Management
* Customer Service Excellence
* Communication Skills
* Team Collaboration
* Documentation Skills
* Time Management
* Escalation Management
* Rotational / 24x7 support environment (if applicable)

description:
**DIGITAL MOJO**

**Google Ads Expert \| Meta Ads \| Growth Strategy**

Full\-Time \| Work From Office \| Banjara Hills, Hyderabad \| Reports to: Pod Manager / Delivery Head

**Company Description**

Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad.

Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.

**Role Description**

We are looking for a Sr. Google Ads Expert with 4\+ years of hands\-on agency experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns while leading high\-performing teams.

This role goes beyond campaign execution. The Sr. Google Ads Expert is responsible for driving performance outcomes across multiple accounts, mentoring team members, building optimization frameworks, improving delivery quality, and contributing to overall agency growth.

You will work closely with Pod Managers, Account Managers, Creative Teams, and senior leadership to ensure performance campaigns consistently achieve business objectives.

This is a leadership role with ownership of both results and people.

**What This Role Is Not**

* Not someone who only manages their own campaigns
* Not someone who escalates every problem instead of solving it
* Not someone focused only on platform metrics without understanding business outcomes
* Not a senior executive role with a different title

**Key Responsibilities**

* Performance Strategy Leadership
* Develop and oversee paid media strategies across Google Ads and Meta Ads
* Build campaign frameworks for lead generation, branding, and conversion\-focused objectives
* Guide campaign planning across Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Meta Feed, Reels, Stories, and Lead Generation campaigns
* Recommend platform mix, budget allocation, and funnel strategy based on business goals
* Team Management and Mentorship
* Lead, mentor, and review the work of Senior Performance Marketers and Performance Marketers
* Conduct regular account reviews and optimization discussions
* Build training frameworks and improve team capability
* Support hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations of team members
* Ensure campaign quality standards are maintained across all accounts
* Performance Ownership
* Own agency\-level performance outcomes across assigned accounts
* Monitor CPL, CTR, CPC, ROAS, lead quality, conversion rates, and budget utilization
* Drive continuous optimization and performance improvement initiatives
* Identify risks early and implement corrective action plans
* Client Strategy and Communication
* Participate in high\-level client strategy discussions
* Present campaign performance and future recommendations confidently
* Handle complex client concerns and performance escalations
* Build long\-term client confidence through strategic thinking and performance delivery
* Budget and Portfolio Management
* Oversee multiple client accounts with significant monthly advertising spends
* Ensure efficient budget allocation across campaigns and platforms
* Review budget pacing, forecasting, and scaling opportunities
* Maintain profitability and performance efficiency across accounts
* Tracking, Analytics and Reporting
* Ensure accurate implementation of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversion APIs, and tracking frameworks
* Review reporting accuracy and campaign insights before client delivery
* Establish reporting standards and dashboard frameworks
* Identify tracking gaps and implement solutions proactively
* Process Improvement and Innovation
* Create and improve performance marketing SOPs, checklists, and optimization frameworks
* Stay updated with platform changes, automation tools, AI tools, and emerging advertising trends
* Drive adoption of best practices across the performance team
* Contribute to new business proposals and growth initiatives

**Key KPIs**

* Account\-Level CPL and ROAS
* Lead Quality Score
* Team Performance Metrics
* Client Retention Rate
* Campaign Growth and Scalability
* Budget Utilization Efficiency
* Reporting Accuracy
* Client Satisfaction
* Team Development and Retention

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 6–8 years of hands\-on experience in a digital marketing agency
* Advanced expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads platforms
* Strong understanding of performance marketing, lead generation, and conversion optimization
* Proven experience managing multiple high\-budget accounts simultaneously
* Strong knowledge of CPL, CPC, CTR, ROAS, ROI, conversion tracking, and attribution models
* Expertise in GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversion APIs, and reporting tools
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Strong English communication and presentation skills
* Experience leading and mentoring performance marketing teams
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Agency experience is mandatory
* Has managed monthly advertising budgets exceeding ₹50 Lakhs\+
* Experience in Lead Generation across Real Estate, Healthcare, Education, B2B, and Lead Generation industries preferred
* Strong client\-facing and leadership experience
* Comfortable managing multiple team members and client accounts simultaneously
* The character in sitcom is Chandler
* Strategic thinker with strong execution capability

**Reporting Structure**

* Reports To: Pod Manager / Delivery Head
* Works Closely With: Account Managers, Creative Team, SEO Team, Business Team
* Client Facing: Yes

**Career Growth**

Performance Marketing Lead → Group Performance Lead → Head of Performance → Delivery Head

**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| Work From Office \| Banjara Hills, Hyderabad

**Benefits**

Health Insurance \| Provident Fund \| Leave Encashment

Pay: ₹800,000\.00 \- ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

description:
**Job Title:** Tele Calling Executive  
**Location:** Begumpet, Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Job Type:** Full\-time, Permanent  
**Schedule:** Day Shift  
**Experience:** 0 to 2 years (Freshers with excellent communication skills are strongly encouraged to apply, Minimum 6 Months Experience in Tele Calling )

**Job Summary :**

We are seeking an enthusiastic **Tele Calling Executive** to join our growth team. You will be the vital first point of contact for aspiring students. Your core objective is to reach out to students who have inquired about studying abroad and convince them to visit our Begumpet office for a free face\-to\-face expert counseling session.

**Key Responsibilities :**

* **Outbound Calling:** Make 80 to 100 calls daily to pre\-qualified leads and online student inquiries.
* **Profile Qualification:** Connect with students to understand their academic background, budget, and target study destinations.
* **Appointment Booking:** Schedule office appointments for students and their parents with our senior counselors.
* **Strict Follow\-ups:** Maintain consistent follow\-ups via phone calls and WhatsApp to ensure high walk\-in show\-up rates.
* **Data Management:** Daily update call statuses and logs inside our Excel sheets or CRM software.

**Requirements \& Skills :**

* **Communication:** Clear, polite, and persuasive telephone etiquette.
* **Languages:** English, Telugu \& Hindi
* **Mindset:** Target\-driven, self\-motivated, and capable of handling daily calling metrics.
* **Tech Comfort:** Basic knowledge of operating computers and spreadsheets.
